videos.description:
Should you spam Wrack in WoW Forever? Yes, as your filler. Never instead of your DoTs.

• Wrack: 31-point Affliction talent, 6 sec channel, no cooldown. While you channel it, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick 100% faster (same duration). It doesn't speed up Bane of Doom.
• Soul Siphon: +12% Wrack damage per DoT on the target, max 36%.
• Nov 10 hotfix: Wrack damage cut 30% and it no longer increases DoT damage. Blizzard said always channeling Wrack was beating also casting your DoTs.
• The loop: Bane of Agony → Corruption + Siphon Life → Wrack as filler. If a DoT is about to drop, cut the channel and refresh it (you keep the progress).
